review_scope: All215 actual Curadi answers, exact queue identities, source-group inference and exceptional endings; no full success/gold-union certification.

literal_a_stem_strengthening.basis: Exact literal-a entries and kathadi final-a deletion/retained-position explanation; first-vowel strengthening is not licensed. Printed or previously source-audited short stems for Cada,laja,kuha,pada,gada,caha,raha,svara,vraRa; paTha short finite stem is explicit general-rule inference from the printed aspirated entry.
literal_a_stem_strengthening.caveat: Does not turn diagnostic stem replacement into acceptance normalization. Some answers additionally use a wrong pada.

intrinsic_middle_ending_mismatch.basis: Independently re-viewed SK1938 scan241 printed237: padadi through garva heading is Atmanepada, with padayate and kuhayate. Kartari is compatible with Atmanepada and does not authorize a free para ending.
intrinsic_middle_ending_mismatch.caveat: The kṛ auxiliary specifically follows main-entry pada. Do not reject valid as/bhu alternatives, nor equate every -etām with a middle optative.

adanta_aorist_unlicensed_i_reduplication.basis: Kashika7.4.93 explicitly excludes aglopin stems, with acakathat control. Printed andha/anka/anga representatives retain the source a in their reduplication. Ansa dental-s entry follows the same general rule.
adanta_aorist_unlicensed_i_reduplication.caveat: A complete general-rule inference is used for the selected endings; no printed attestation of every selected paradigm cell is claimed.

mixed_intrinsic_nic_and_no_nic_branches.basis: Independently viewed SK237 includes garva in the middle group, prints garvayate, then allows nic optionally. With nic its caN stem ajagarv- takes middle endings; the no-nic para branch uses the sigmatic aorist. These cannot be combined into ajagarv- plus para endings.
mixed_intrinsic_nic_and_no_nic_branches.caveat: The entire no-nic paradigm is not independently certified; the branch compatibility contradiction suffices for these five submitted forms.

adanta_aorist_reversed_vowel_quantities.basis: Independently viewed SK237 directly prints ababhamat(with long ā), ajugomat and atitirat(with long ī in the second root syllable). Ag-lopa blocks the ordinary shortening/san-like long-reduplication treatment. All four answers use the reversed quantity pattern.
adanta_aorist_reversed_vowel_quantities.caveat: Printed3sg controls plus general tense/person endings; not every final form printed.

documentation_corrections.change: Replace7.2.115 as the putative first-vowel strengthening rule with7.2.116 for a-upadha vṛddhi and7.3.86 for light-upadha guṇa (kuha). Retain6.4.48 and the explicit retained-position explanation.
documentation_corrections.disposition_impact: none; argument already rejects the same wrong stem

documentation_corrections.change: Use the inspected1938 Siddhantakaumudi238 and Kshiratarangini333 entry321 as the exact short-Cada witnesses. The reviewed dependency list does not establish a photographed Balamanorama Cada passage; its puK/kathadi page is a different source finding.
documentation_corrections.disposition_impact: none; two inspected exact lexical witnesses remain

documentation_corrections.change: Add exact1.3.63 for kṛ auxiliary inheritance and3.4.102 for thematic middle optative dual. Preserve valid para as/bhū alternatives and no blanket-pada normalization.
documentation_corrections.disposition_impact: none; source documentation made more precise
